title: Finite-module extension of an actual Kummer coefficient generator
statement: Let X be a scheme, m a nonzero integer, q a degree and x a class in Hq(X,mu_m). Assume M↦Hq(X,mu_m tensor M) preserves finite colimits for modules over R=ULift(Z/m). If a↦Hq(i_a)(x) is bijective for M=R, it is bijective for every finite R-module M. The maps are the specified pure-tensor coefficient insertion maps.

source.place: Coefficients, finite free presentation version of the coefficient argument.

proof.text: On sections, tensor distributivity and additivity of the sheafification unit prove i_(a+b)=i_a+i_b. Naturality of that unit for tensoring a module morphism f proves i_a followed by twist(f) equals i_(f(a)). Applying the additive cohomology functor to x defines a natural transformation from the underlying additive-group functor to twisted cohomology. The forgetful functor preserves colimits; the other functor preserves finite colimits by hypothesis. The residue-ring component is invertible by hR. Apply isIso_app_of_rankOne_of_finite to obtain invertibility at every finite module, then use the concrete-category bijectivity criterion.

theorem kummer_coefficient_generator_bijective (X : Scheme.{u}) (m q : ℕ) [NeZero m]
    (x : ((Sheaf.functorH X.smallEtaleTopology q :
      Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (X.rootsOfUnitySheaf m)))
    (hG : PreservesFiniteColimits
      (kummerAbelianTwist X m ⋙
        (Sheaf.functorH X.smallEtaleTopology q : _ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})))
    (hR : Function.Bijective (fun a : ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m) ↦
      Sheaf.H.map (kummerCoefficientInsertion X m (ModuleCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m))
        (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m))) a) q x))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m))) [Finite M] :
    Function.Bijective (fun a : M ↦
      Sheaf.H.map (kummerCoefficientInsertion X m M a) q x)
